 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Serbisyopubliko Serbisyo Publiko WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions for Wednesday, October 28, 2026 
 By GMA News Published October 27, 2026 1:45pm 
 Updated October 28, 2026 9:48am + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Face-to-face classes in some areas and schools for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, have been suspended in some areas and schools due to increasing reports of illness among students, and preparations for the inaugural session of the First Bangsamoro Regular Parliament and the 20th ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and 13th ADMM-Plus.
 Below are the class suspensions for Wednesday, October 28, 2026:
 Philippine Science High School-Main Campus : no face-to-face classes. Classes to shift to online learning setup on Wednesday, October 28, to Thursday, October 29.
 Bicol University - alternative learning modalities, on the morning of Wednesday, October 28, 2026
 Legazpi West
 Legazpi East
 Daraga
 Cotabato City : Classes at all levels including graduate and professional programs will shift to asynchronous learning from October 26 to 31 in preparation for the inaugural session of the First Bangsamoro Regular Parliament.
 Lapu-Lapu City , Cebu: no face-to-face classes. Asynchronous classes will be implemented from October 26 to 30 in the following schools as the city hosts the 20th ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and 13th ADMM-Plus:
 public and private elementary and high schools in the barangays of Ibo, Buaya, Mactan, and P. Engaño
 Private Schools Sto. Niño International School
 EMD Carmelite School Foundation
 Jose Alwins Learning School
 B Cebu Dream Foundation, Inc.
 Cebu International Language TVI Center
 Global Leaders International School
 Newtown School of Excellence
 St. Joseph’s School of Mactan
 Sto. Niño Child Academy
 Colleges Lapu-Lapu City College
 Lapu-Lapu Cebu International College
 Sto. Niño Mactan College
 Sarangani Province: No face-to-face classes and suspension of work in all government offices due to the magnitude 5.5 earthquake that struck at around 7:43 AM
